system.description:
Dream Walker

Medium Illusory Construct

Armor Class 13 + your proficiency bonus

Hit Points 11 + Proficiency Bonus + your level.

Speed 30 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +0 | + | CON | +0 | + | WIS | +0 | + |

| DEX | +0 | + | INT | +0 | + | CHA | +0 | + |

Save Proficiencies All

Dream Walker Type

Dream Beast. +3 Str, Con. +2 Dex, Wis. Resistant to Acid, Bludgeoning and Earth damage. +20ft speed.

Dream Demon. +3 Str, Cha. +2 Con, Int. Resistant to Fire, Necrotic and Slashing damage. +20ft speed.

Dream Dragon. +3 Int, Con. +2 Dex, Cha. Resistant to Force, Lightning and Wind damage. 30ft Fly speed.

Dream Fey. +3 Wis, Con. +2 Dex, Cha. Resistant to Cold, Poison and Psychic damage. 30ft Fly speed.

Dream Spider. +3 Dex, Wis. +2 Str, Con. Resistant to Physical and Elemental Conditions. 60ft climb speed

Dream Walker Traits

Strong Dreams. Increase all modifiers by +1 at 7th level and again at 15th level.

Illusory Construct. This creature cannot physically interact with the environment and cannot be more than 60 feet away from their summoner before being dispelled. It can move through the spaces of other creatures as if they were difficult terrain. It reduces its hit points by 5 if it ends its turn inside an object where its summoner cannot see it. If an effect it uses requires a saving throw, it uses either your Ninjutsu or Genjutsu save DC.

Attacks

Strike (Melee). Melee Genjutsu Attack: 5ft., one target. Highest Mod + Prof to hit, 1d8 + Mod psychic damage. This increases to 2d8 at 11th

Strike (Ranged). Ranged Genjutsu Attack: 30ft., one target. Highest Mod + Prof to hit, 1d6 + Mod psychic damage. This increases to 2d6 at 11th

Abilities

Beast Pounce. One creature within15 feet must make an Intelligence Saving throw, being knocked prone and Dazed on a failed save.

Demons Bargain. Once creature within 20 feet must make a Wisdom Saving throw, going Berserk on a failed save. Once this ability is used it cannot be used again until the end of your next turn.

Dragons Breath. All creatures in a 30-foot cone must make a Charisma saving throw, being Weakened on a failed save.

Fey Trickery. One creature within 60 feet must make an Intelligence saving throw, being Dazzled on a failed save.

Spiders Web. All creatures within a 10-foot cube, centering on a point you can see within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw, being Concussed on a failed save.

1st Level Clan Feature

Whenever you awake from a rest, you bring something from your dreams with you, a Dream Walker. A Dream Walker is an illusory construct given life and form by your subconscious. You choose the type of Dream Walker from the following list: Dream Fey, Dream Beast, Dream Dragon, Dream Spider, Dream Demon.

Use the Dream Walker stat block found as part of this clan, and apply the specific Dream types traits. Your Dream Walker grows in strength alongside you, and can affect the waking world so long as you can prevent it from falling to 0 hit points. When it does, its dispelled, until you complete your next rest. Your Dream Walker regains all missing hit points when you complete a rest.

Alternatively, when you cast a Jutsu or use a feature that summons a chakra construct, or when you complete your rest while you have a jutsu on your known list that summons a chakra construct, you can spend 2 Oni-Coils to use that creatures stat block as your Dream Walker.

Your Dream Walker only obeys you and doesn’t acknowledge the existence of anyone else unless you command it to. It only obeys your commands. In combat, it acts on your turn. You can command your Dream Walker to do the following:

Move. At no action cost to you, you can command your Dream Walker to move its full movement.

Strike. As part of an attack made with your Attack action or a Jutsu you cast that makes attacks, you can forgo any number of attacks to command your Dream Walker to use its Strike attack.

Distort. As a bonus action, you can command your Dream Walker to use its associated ability. If an ability calls for a saving throw, you use either your Ninjutsu or Genjutsu jutsu save DC.

Pass Through. Starting at 7th level, as part of casting a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu you know, you can have your jutsu originate from your Dream Walker.

Inflict Harm. Starting at 7th level, as part of casting a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu you know, you can have your Dream Walker perform the attacks and use their Strikes in place of [Unarmed] or [Weapon Damage].
